title: Common-predecessor comparison is independent of the span
statement:
Let $I$ be a nonempty ordinary category [def-nagata-category] that is cofiltered: any two objects receive morphisms from a common object, and every pair of parallel morphisms $u,v:i\to j$ is equalized by a morphism $t:k\to i$ with $ut=vt$. Let $\mathcal D$ be an ordinary category [def-nagata-category] and $F:I\to\mathcal D$ a functor (a map on objects and morphisms preserving sources, targets, identities and composition) sending every morphism to an isomorphism (a morphism with a two-sided inverse). For objects $c,d$ of $I$ and any two spans $c\xleftarrow{r}e\xrightarrow{s}d$ and $c\xleftarrow{r'}e'\xrightarrow{s'}d$, the following morphisms from $F(c)$ to $F(d)$ agree:
$$F(s)\circ F(r)^{-1}=F(s')\circ F(r')^{-1}.$$
